text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Applying the periodic consolidation technique described in the arXiv paper (13b3b6fa) to the naive‑append baseline used in the ablation study (db8849d5) will cut the token‑budget blow‑up and narrow the ~9 F1‑point performance gap with the rewrite operation.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["db8849d5","13b3b6fa"],"tags":["consolidation","ablation","efficiency","memory"]},{"statement":"The aggressive consolidation step that rescued recall in the bounded‑memory variant (623631bc) is effectively an implementation of the cross‑fact‑interference‑reducing consolidation method (13b3b6fa); therefore, adding the same consolidation schedule to the rewrite‑based memory‑rewrite system should further improve its scalability and recall stability over longer streams.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["623631bc","13b3b6fa"],"tags":["consolidation","bounded‑memory","scalability","recall"]}]}
